thread:
Priya (sec-eng): Heads-up — some embeddings-only API keys started returning chat completions after the KMS rewrap at 10:42 UTC. Repro + logs below.

Priya (sec-eng): Repro:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-emb-xxxxx" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-open-1","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}]}'
```
Expected 403; observed 200 + message id. Audit snippet: 
```
audit_id=acb1234 event=token_auth token_id=sk-emb-xxxxx scopes=[embeddings] policy_tags=[rewrap:2026-03-20]
```

Ethan (eng-infra): Which KMS operation? rewrap-to-new-key? Did metadata get lost on rewrap? Can you paste the KMS metadata and the authz check log?

Priya (sec-eng): It was rewrap-to-new-key via rewrap job v2. KMS response shows metadata.tags=[k:models:allowlist=embeddings] but authz lookup shows missing tag. Authz log:
```
INFO authz: token=sk-emb-xxxxx scopes_resolved=[embeddings] allowed_routes=[/v1/embeddings] checked_routes=[/v1/chat/completions] decision=ALLOW
```

Kaitlin (devex): Is customer impact limited to a few keys or wide? Any hosted customers reporting production incidents?

Priya (sec-eng): So far 3 customers flagged anomalies (one production). All are hosted keys created before rewrap.

Marcus (sre): @Ethan can we hotfix by adding a runtime rule: deny chat completions for tokens with explicit "embeddings-only" scope unless an allowlist override exists? Quick patch to authz service + hot reload.

Ethan (eng-infra): We can push a deny rule in ~30m to the authz policy engine. But we should avoid false denies — add a guard to only apply for tokens with rewrap:2026-03-20 tag.

ops-bot: Incident created: https://internal/incident/INC-2026-120 — severity P2 — assigned to eng-infra + eng-security

Kaitlin (devex): I'll draft customer comms notifying the 3 affected accounts, wait for confirmation before sending.

Priya (sec-eng): Next steps: (1) Ethan to deploy deny rule (ETA 30m) (2) Eng-infra to re-run rewrap with metadata preservation and invalidate authz cache (3) eng-security to audit all tokens rewrapped in 10:42-10:55 window and run a scope sanity check (4) Kaitlin to handle comms. @Ethan @Kaitlin assignable?

Ethan (eng-infra): Assigned. Will post progress.

Marcus (sre): Add to postmortem: audit logs missed a "tag-missing" alert. Suggest adding an automated KMS tag consistency check after rewrap jobs.

Priya (sec-eng): Agree. Also capture for compliance: list of affected tokens and export to secure storage for the audit. I'll start the export.

Ethan (eng-infra): Update — deny rule deployed. Turning up monitoring for any 403->200 flips. Will follow up with a runbook to unstick authz caches.

Priya (sec-eng): Thanks. I'll update incident and tag this thread. Will loop back with RCA draft in 24h.

Kaitlin (devex): Noted. I'll prepare a short customer note template.

Marcus (sre): Good job. :thumbsup:
